Rajasthan Govt Jobs: Recruitment for Medical Officers and Sanitation Workers Announced

The Rajasthan government has announced recruitment for 600 Medical Officer positions, with the application deadline approaching. Additionally, the state is hiring for 24,752 Sanitation Worker positions, and the application deadline for this recruitment has been extended for a second time.
